title: Storage: one data model, three backends
description:
One data model (`web/amplify/data/resource.ts`) served by three backends, so Apricitus can query the structured data it now collects (clips + analysis, slices, markers, candidates, verdicts, crates, scores, provenance).

| Backend | For | Protocol |
|---|---|---|
| **Cloud**: AWS Amplify Gen2 (AppSync, DynamoDB, S3, Cognito + Google) | hosted web app | GraphQL |
| **Local direct**: embedded Rust engine on a library folder | Swift app (UniFFI), Python analysis (PyO3), CLI | Amplify-shaped operations, no GraphQL |
| **Local GraphQL**: `apricitus serve` over the same engine and folder | web app without AWS | GraphQL, same schema as AppSync |

Design (the spec every task cites): `design/storage.md` (§0–§7). General engine work goes upstream into Virtuus (`~/Projects/Virtuus`, board `virt`).

## Definition of done
- The conformance corpus (`features/data/`) is green through the Rust engine (and Swift via UniFFI), through `apricitus serve` with the real `aws-amplify` client, and through an Amplify sandbox.
- The current library migrates idempotently; every example score renders sample-identical before and after.
- The web app runs from `apricitus serve` (local) and from Amplify (cloud, Google sign-in); a library round-trips local → cloud → local unchanged.

## Sub-agent protocol (every task)
1. `kbs show <id>`; read the repo's `AGENTS.md`, `CONTRIBUTING_AGENT.md`, and the cited `design/storage.md` sections.
2. `kbs update <id> --status in_progress`.
3. Specs first: write the Gherkin/tests, watch them fail, write the smallest code to pass.
4. Log plan, decisions and problems with `kbs comment <id> "…" --agent-platform "Claude Code" --agent-model "Claude Haiku 4.5" --agent-name "storage-<task>"`.
5. Run the task's **Verify** commands; paste the tail of the output in a comment.
6. `kbs update <id> --add-label ready-for-review` and stop. Never close issues, commit, push, publish, deploy, or touch `project/` except through `kbs`.
7. Blocked or unsure: comment the question, `kbs update <id> --add-label needs-decision`, stop.
